title: agent-engine: 10 fixes for step/run lifecycle, state leaks, and race conditions

sections.what: Fix 10 issues in agent-engine.ts around step/run lifecycle, state leaks, and race conditions
sections.why: Found during code review: stepOnce missing cleanup, stale state leaking between runs, unbounded history growth, missing timeouts, duplicate fetch logic, controllingPlayer resolution scattered, turnNumber desync, max-steps counter wrong for single steps, reflection never fires in simultaneous mode, and null-check ordering bug
sections.how: Apply 10 targeted fixes in agent-engine.ts and turn-queue.ts

acceptance.text: All 10 fixes applied and verified: stepOnce has finally block, paused state reset, dead character cleanup, sim deadlines cleared on stop, turnNumber synced, LLM timeout added, fetch deduplication, controllingPlayer centralized, stepsRun reset in stepOnce, per-char turn counter for reflection, null-check moved up

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: simulation controls (Run, Pause, Step Once)

Current availability: always

Live steps when available:
1. Load any scenario with characters
2. Click Run - verify it starts
3. Click Pause - verify it pauses
4. Click Step Once - verify single step executes without Already running
5. Refresh page, click Step Once immediately - no Step cancelled
6. Run until a character dies - verify no memory leak in console
7. Run in simultaneous mode - verify reflection fires every 5 turns per character

This section defines intended access and live acceptance. It is not a claim that planned UI exists or works today. Current availability says what is implemented and verified now; the numbered steps say how to reach and test the intended surface once it is available.
